sequenceDiagram
    autonumber
    par First operation
        A->>B: Request
        opt Cached
            B-->>A: Cached response
        end
    and Second operation
        A->>C: Other request
        critical Reserve resource
            C->>C: Acquire lock
        option Resource unavailable
            C-->>A: Retry
        end
    end
